exposure: partial term prelabor rupture of membranes (partial TPROM)
complete term prelabor rupture of membranes (complete TPROM)
outcome: spontaneous onset of labor within 24 hours
cohort: The study included all singleton cephalic pregnancies presenting with prelabor rupture of membranes at or after 37 weeks gestational age.
finding: Partial term prelabor rupture of membranes (partial TPROM) was associated with a significantly lower probability of spontaneous labor within 24 hours compared to complete TPROM.
